concepts.title: The Night Taylor Swift Vanished
concepts.premise: A night nurse finds Taylor Swift asleep in a hospital corridor and learns what she saw on the stage that night.
cast: Taylor Swift: a famous singer who hides in the hospital
beats: Mara finds a stranger asleep in a corridor.
The stranger asks her to hide something.
Mara learns what the stranger is running from.
Mara decides whether to keep the secret.
